body.cap: Dami An, CEO of FutureSense, introduces the company’s food traceability solution 'Food4Chain' to AVING News reporter Alex Sigrist at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: FutureSense Co. Ltd. (CEO Dami An) participated in CES 2025, held from January 7 to 10 (local time) in Las Vegas, as part of the Incheon IFEZ Pavilion. The company presented its flagship cloud platform, Food4Chain, which targets food manufacturers and global supply chains to enhance productivity, compliance, and management efficiency in food production and supply chain operations.

Food4Chain leverages AI and big data technologies to collect and analyze critical data while securely storing regulatory documentation through blockchain technology. This ensures high reliability and utility, positioning FutureSense as a leader in the digital transformation of the food industry and a contributor to building a sustainable and safe food ecosystem.

FutureSense showcased the Food4Chain platform’s capabilities at CES 2025. The traceability service enables seamless compliance with stringent global food regulations, such as those from the FDA and the EU. It also offers easy supply chain data management and updates users on regulatory changes.

The platform’s Chain-of-Custody feature highlights FutureSense’s advanced blockchain expertise, ensuring transparent and trustworthy supply chain data management. This capability provides robust tracking solutions tailored to meet evolving regulatory requirements.

body.cap: Dami An, CEO of FutureSense, showcases 'Food4Chain' to AVING News reporter Alex Sigrist at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The inventory and loss rate management service also integrates real-time data collection via mobile devices. This feature analyzes key performance indicators (KPIs) to support management teams’ decision-making. Its lot-level traceability ensures an effective response to recall issues, enhancing operational efficiency.

A FutureSense representative said, “By participating in CES, the largest IT and electronics exhibition in North America, we aim to introduce our solutions to food buyers, manufacturers, and distributors targeting the North American market. This event provides a unique platform to showcase Food4Chain’s advantages and distinctiveness while fostering partnerships and connecting with potential clients.”

The representative also emphasized the platform’s compatibility with major enterprise solutions: “With over 2,000 top global food companies already using SAP ERP solutions, Food4Chain has garnered significant attention in the U.S. for its ability to support the FDA’s rapidly tightening food traceability requirements while seamlessly integrating with existing ERP systems.”
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
